2026-09-16 (card-results AI-fact-elimination sweep, fin/37): scoped `apply-recognizers.mjs summon-primal-garuda` rerun (the FIRST check this sweep's own process requires) closed 2 of the 5 unprovenanced facts for real: chapters II/III's Slipstream pump+grantKeyword facts are now covered by `pumpTarget-effect-structural.ts`/`grantKeywordTarget-effect-structural.ts`'s own `owner`/`notSelf` extension (landed 2026-09-15/16, after this card's last triage pass) — this card's own real 'Another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains flying until end of turn' is explicitly named as a matched case in both recognizers' own module doc comments, it just hadn't been re-run against this specific card's `synergy.json` yet (exactly the 'existing recognizer, just not re-applied' case this sweep's process doc calls out first). Wrote 2 new parser-derived facts (pump+excludeSelf, grantKeyword+excludeSelf+untilEndOfTurn). Hand-edited `synergy.json` to drop the OLD unprovenanced `grantKeyword` fact (no `excludeSelf`) since the new recognizer-derived one is a strict, verified superset (same event/keyword/controller/target-types/targeted/untilEndOfTurn, plus the real `excludeSelf` narrowing this card's own 'ANOTHER target creature' text actually requires) — a genuinely stale/superseded duplicate, not a judgment call. Did NOT drop the OLD `pump` fact (still unprovenanced) even though a new recognizer-derived `pump` fact now also exists alongside it: found a real, confirmed bug in `pumpTarget-effect-structural.ts` while comparing them — its own fact-construction code (the `facts.push` at the bottom of `recognizePumpTargetEffectStructural`) never includes `untilEndOfTurn` in the emitted Fact at all, even though `effect.untilEndOfTurn` is read earlier in the SAME function to build the required text pattern's tail (`const tail = effect.untilEndOfTurn ? ... : ''`) — the field is read but never propagated to the output. Confirmed this isn't a one-off: `magic-damper`'s own EXISTING `synergy.json` still carries a `pump` fact under this identical rule WITH `untilEndOfTurn:true` — almost certainly stale output from an earlier version of this recognizer that DID propagate it, left untouched since `apply-recognizers.mjs` never overwrites an already-written fact. Sibling `grantKeywordTarget-effect-structural.ts` does NOT have this bug (correctly includes `untilEndOfTurn:true`, confirmed in this card's own new fact). Since dropping the old `pump` fact would lose real `untilEndOfTurn` information the new one doesn't (yet) carry, kept both rather than treating it as a stale duplicate — escalating the propagation bug to the recognizer lane as a precise, cited fix (once fixed, the new fact becomes a true superset and the old one can then be dropped as stale, same as grantKeyword just was).

Remaining 3 unprovenanced facts (chapter I's Aerial Blast damage + its own sink, both still `kind:'custom'`): re-attempted for real per this sweep's standing instruction not to just re-flag the sibling engine-lane task's own prior finding. Confirmed directly against `card.ts`: `kind:'dealDamageTarget'` has an `owner?: EffectOwner` field (would express 'an opponent controls') but NO `tapped` filter field at all — migrating onto it today would silently drop the real 'target TAPPED creature' restriction (a false, broader textual claim), not just leave it unprovenanced. `Constraints.tapped` (synergy.ts) is confirmed still purely documentary pool-wide (not consulted by the matcher), so even a hypothetical fact-level-only fix wouldn't make this migratable without an actual engine-level `dealDamageTarget.tapped` field. This remains genuinely blocked on an engine-core vocabulary gap (a tapped-aware `dealDamageTarget`, or a dedicated custom-effect recognizer, per the sibling task's own already-correct diagnosis) — re-verified true today, not stale, and I have no safe migration path from my own write-fenced lane (no `card.ts`/`recognizers/*` access). `verify-synergy.mjs`/`verify-text-coverage.mjs` (scoped): 0 hard failures both before and after my edit, same pre-existing soft notes (lore-counter/self-enters, unrelated to this pass).
